holder-quote: Dame Talia rode with Rabbiteater. She looked at the Goblin. She was not the only one. He didn’t know how a tribe of Goblins cheered him. The Flooded Water’s champion. A symbol.
if anyone knew what Rabbiteater’s new Skills did, it would be them.
I reference ‘Ser Solstice’ as a [Knight] and [Aura of the Hearth] and [Aura of the Brave] for lookup in their libraries.

effect-quote: it made the air around him change. Manifesting the vision in his heart.
